summary: Source-graded garlic clinical evidence summary with uncertainty and negative findings.

practice_claims.condition_or_goal: Some garlic supplements may reduce total and LDL cholesterol to a small extent in people with elevated cholesterol
practice_claims.preparation: various oral garlic supplements; not equivalent products
practice_claims.limitations: NCCIH synthesis; magnitude and consistency vary; no proof of cardiovascular event prevention.

practice_claims.condition_or_goal: Consuming garlic does not appear to reduce stomach-cancer risk
practice_claims.limitations: Negative risk association summary, not an experiment establishing treatment; colorectal-cancer association remains uncertain.
